name: maestro
description: A collection of Claude Code plugins for orchestrating solo development workflows.

plugins.name: baton
plugins.description: Context-aware, beads-backed git-worktree workflow orchestrator. Auto-detects which context (project set) you're in, dispatches tasks to isolated worker sessions, and cleans up on your say-so.

plugins.name: fermata
plugins.description: Session-record hooks for the fermata terminal dashboard (fermata hook <event>). Needs the fermata binary installed with cargo.
